Computer Science programs are designed to prepare students for an industrial, business, or governmental career in keeping with the fast-growing computer science industry. The California Lutheran University offers majors and minors in both computer science and computer information systems, and certificates in information technology and information systems.

The program includes study of Personal Computer laboratories, a study area for majors, and electronic classrooms with large screen projection systems for lectures, as well as faculty offices. Small classes allow faculty members to provide individualized attention to students and their projects and research.

The department also maintains an experimental networking lab, which runs various network operating systems. The department is fully connected to the Internet and every lab Personal Computer or workstation has complete Internet access.

The University's computer science graduates often pursue careers that utilize their skills in software and hardware development, programming, computer use in businesses, computer engineering and education.

The Master of Science in Management (MSM) is a one-year program designed for professionals who do not hold a business degree or don’t have extensive experience in the field. An excellent option for those who want to enhance their industry-specific experience with foundational business knowledge, this degree can help students unlock higher-level roles or transition into management.

This program covers management theory and practice, giving learners the skills that help them navigate the business world with confidence. They will learn the language of business so that they can communicate effectively with peers, stakeholders and leaders.
4mrg:
The Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Finance is an expanding field of study that's creating new opportunities for skilled professionals to step into significant leadership roles. These roles will be in high demand and command generous salaries that graduates will want to be poised to secure.

Students will gain the vital, relevant skills to take on any challenge they will face on their career path through specialized curriculum taught by world-renowned faculty, recognized for their expertise in the field, and work experience in the corporate residency program.

The California Lutheran University faculty in the classroom will focus on financial results by company, division, product, or business unit, getting deep understanding of budgeting, forecasting, and analysis. Students will be exposed to pricing and expense analysis for new products or global expansion, merger and acquisition analysis, treasury functions, and more.
